must_haves: security and where data is stored (Stockholm)

layout.idea: Newspaper front page: masthead with today's date and 'Stockholm', a lead story about the draft card across 8 columns, a 4-column side rail 'Also in this edition' for providers and plans.
layout.why: News layout carries a lot of content densely and makes the Stockholm data location part of the masthead.

hero.idea: Three-frame sequence: three stills left to right (Connect, Ask, Approve), the same size, captioned 1, 2, 3.
hero.why: The whole product in one row.

visual_style.idea: Framed prints: screenshots sit on cream mats with thin ink frames like prints on a wall, captions under each in small caps.
visual_style.why: Treats the product UI as the art.

typography.idea: IBM Plex Sans Condensed 600 headings, IBM Plex Sans 400 body, IBM Plex Mono 400 labels: one superfamily, manual style.
typography.why: Engineering-manual coherence with zero pairing risk.

narrative.idea: Install-led: start from 'You already use Claude or ChatGPT', show the install, then what to ask first.
narrative.why: Matches visitors who arrive from client directories.

proof.idea: Open by default: links to the public GitHub repository, the npm package and the docs, with 'read the code' as a secondary link.
proof.why: Anyone can check how it works.

asset_use.idea: Chat and inbox side by side, joined by a hairline that connects the message in the chat to the same message in the inbox.

motion.idea: Before and after screenshot crossfade on a slow 5-second loop, paused on hover.
motion.why: Shows change over time with no interaction needed.

section_order.idea: Masthead and lead story > Providers column > How it works > Latest changelog dispatches > Pricing > Colophon
section_order.why: Newspaper order for the newspaper layout.

voice.why: Fast to scan, easy to remember.

wildcard.idea: Providers drawn as numbered field-guide plates I to XII.
wildcard.why: Turns the logo wall into an artefact.
